followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I picked Petrel because the query is a straightforward, benign comparison task with no safety-sensitive content, so the decisive factor was raw capability and instruction-following. Petrel's internal evals (Summarization 86.4, Extraction & Retrieval 85.3, Creative Generation 84.7) meet or beat Plover's across the board, and its public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2, IFEval 89.8, Arena-Hard 90.6) are clearly higher. Petrel also tracks multi-part constraints more reliably and "degrades gracefully on underspecified inputs," which suits an open-ended "list the differences" request better than Plover, which self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work. Petrel's moderation-tuned desensitization wasn't relevant here, so it came down to general quality—where Petrel wins.
